title: Avoid treating curved position and velocity directions as quadratically passive
statement: For the specified affine connection, the native reports that every time-dependent quadratic b with positive semidefinite covariant Hessian and exact annihilation of V has b=alpha W^2/2+beta W+gamma t+delta, alpha>=0, if K is invertible at even one time on the connected interval. Hessian rank is at most one.

requires: The exact auxiliary connection and vector field V
Quadratic b, positive semidefinite Hessian and exact zero pairing
provides: Reported obstruction to adding passive quadratic position/velocity directions
assumptions: K invertible at one time on a connected interval
Flat case admits higher-rank passive velocity backgrounds
Nonquadratic backgrounds, nonzero controlled pairing and different lifts are not excluded
costs: Must verify the positivity, exact annihilation and curvature hypotheses
contract.units: Auxiliary Hessian rank; not general physical curvature rigidity
contract.obstruction: Complete coefficient-classification proof unavailable; no general all-background no-go theorem.

evidence.range_scope: Reported quadratic classification with crucial invertibility and connection restriction.
